title: South Carolina Code of Laws Title 41, Chapter 35 - Employment and Workforce - Benefits and Claims
source_id: S.C. Code Ann. tit. 41, ch. 35 (secs. 41-35-10 to 41-35-760)
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 41 chapter index (https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/title41.php): chapter row 'CHAPTER 35 - EMPLOYMENT AND WORKFORCE-BENEFITS AND CLAIMS' with no [REPEALED] marker; then fetched https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/t41c035.php, whose heading reads 'CHAPTER 35 / Employment and Workforce-Benefits and Claims', with Article 1 (Regular Benefits), Article 3 (Extended Benefits) and Article 5 (Allowance of Claims), running from SECTION 41-35-10 to SECTION 41-35-760. Currency: current through the 2025 Session.
notes: Unemployment benefit entitlement, eligibility, disqualification and the claims procedure - the most rule-dense everyday benefit statute in the South Carolina Code. Means-tested public assistance is a different statute: Title 43, Chapter 5 (Public Aid, Assistance and Relief Generally), which carries Article 4 (Aid to Dependent Children), Article 7 (WIC) and Article 9 (South Carolina Family Independence Act of 1995) and was verified in force on https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/title43.php, but is not listed because only one statute per topic is recorded.
